name: Label.xmind
text:
# Sheet: 画布 1
- Label
  - Content
    - Standard format
      - In English
      - With Saga telecom's model name and descriptions
    - It is fine to use customer's local language
Such as Italian, Russian, Korean...
      - Customers should provide correct expression to avoid any confusion
    - It is fine to put customer's logo/model name in the label
  - Serial Number
    - This is important and will be used in after-sales cases
    - An agreed format should be applied and recorded
  - It is fine to use customer self-supplied labels in an order
